# ADR-0003: DTO TS bindings are generated by ts-rs, never hand-mirrored

Date: 2026-09-26 · Status: accepted

## Decision
Every wire-facing struct carries `derive(TS)`; a `cargo test -p kovaaks-tauri` run emits the TS files into `ui/src/lib/bindings/`. `api.ts` re-exports and holds only invoke wrappers.

## Consequences
Wire field drift becomes a ui-build compile error instead of a runtime symptom on the user's desktop. Do not hand-edit binding files.
